Live Tracking & ETA Accuracy.text: The only purpose of this app is to help real time tracking of the cab, which never happens, it always gets stuck at some point and then i have to keep calling my transport department to get the location of cab. Not expected out of such time bounded work we do and need to reach on time to work, this causes a lot of issue with missing the cab. Please fix the bugs!

Every now and then i receive notifications saying that I have an older version in my mobile and reminds me to update it to the latest version. When I open playstore to upgrade the same, i would already been using the latest one. Further, when i try to track the vehicle, app doesn't work 100% as it seldom updates the location and all of a sudden the cab location changes by miles. Also, 9 out of 10 times it wouldn't connect to the driver and always has issues reaching them through app dialing.

It worked for 2 days after installation but now app itself is not opening (shows only opening screen). Many of my colleagues are also facing the same issue. Tried reinstalling and all but nothing happened. Now daily I have to connect with my employer and then to driver to get the pickup time and his location. Could be improved on location accuracy also only if app starts working.

One of the worst app. While tracking the cab in map. It's automatically zooming out after 3 4 seconds. Have to zoom in again. It's very frustrating. Besides the tracking is not accurate. OTPs are changing all of sudden. Worst case I've ever faced in the app is, OTP changed after my trip started and the end OTP is not accepting. You guys really have to look into this issues.

App Stability & Crash on Launch/Update.text: When I open the app to see where the location of the cab is then It says" move in sync keeps stopping " This is happening after the update please look into it ASAP It's not letting me to see the cab drivers number, location, not allowing me to make a call to the driver , this is becoming pretty inconvenient

The worst app I have ever seen. The app crashes frequently in first place. When try to make booking or update details it stops working and get closed by itself. After many attempts of reinstallation, still issue continues. When checking the vehicle location, it is not showing the correct location. In short, data, energy and time waste. Please fix. Being in market for long years is not so important, providing user friendly digital service and making the travel experience peaceful is much needed

The app frequently crashes or hangs while booking cabs, which makes it really frustrating, especially when I’m in a hurry. The GPS tracking is unreliable—it often shows the driver in the wrong location, causing unnecessary delays. Notifications are delayed or sometimes don’t come at all, so I end up missing important updates about my ride.

It doesn't allow to add feedback at the time of travel. This is not good because people tend to miss feedback notifications that appear late after the trip is complete even when they have feedback. The rate your trip notifications are not available for some dates under the bell icon even for a successful trip. The app developers have to understand that feedback is an important means of communication between transport team and employees who use the cab facility.  EDIT: I have provided detail feedback to them with screenshots about defective functionality on Jan 21,2019.  There is no update on that.

Ride Booking, Cutoff & Slots.text: Date: 19-July-2019 Can have lots of improvement in terms of GUI. its not user friendly, a person might get confused while scheduling for pick and drop. Moreover if the company does not provide full access on booking the cab ourselves then there is no use even if the app is world class with all options. I know its not the designers mistake. The interface looks like a beginner's design, good for a beginner.

It used to be really good. But from last few months the App has been very very slow and it's a pain to use it for a single booking.. Developers please fix the issues and release a stable version for users. The bugs are so obvious that if you do the testing you will notice the lags , sloweness, inconsistency.

The app does not let me book cab. It shows that there are no slots for that day but when I go to website and try to book the same, it works. Also, live tracking is completely unreliable. It ends up having an argument with the driver since when the cab driver is at my location, app shows that it is still 20-25 mins away.

One of the worst applications that I have used recently. My corporate company has a tie up with move in sync for providing cabs. The scheduling of cabs is very bad.Pick up must be scheduled 8 hrs before in the morning and 1 hr before in the evening. It doesn't even provide cancellation option.

Login, Session Logout & Auth.text: Waste app does not even deserve a single star and the people from transport department (Wells Fargo) are worst than this application. This application does not show log out if we stretch as it shows only ad hoc and even after booking adhoc the cab is not alloted. Hence we have to arrange the transport by ourselves, then whats the use of this application??

Under Bookings "Login and logouts" interface are very confusing. I don't know why they have made it so complicated. Under a particular date there should be "Login and Logout" in this app under a date it's "Logout and Login" which makes users very confusing which will impact to "No Show". It's not user friendly and this app needs a smart upgrade. Especially it's very complicated for night shift employees.

The app isn't working since past 2 days. I am unable to book the cab. The screen is just loading. Please fix the issue asap. I logged out and logged in multiple times. And also installed and uninstalled the app. Unable to book the cab. I have to book the cab in next 4 hrs. Please fix it asap. It's been a week, I haven't received any reply. My app is still not working. I need it to he fixed asap.

There are a few suggestions which if done will make the app more user friendly: 1. If the cab arrangement is irrespective of number of bookings, and the same (approx ~20 seater) traveller comes everyday, then probably the feature of booking the cab atleast a week before can be eliminated. 2. Since the user is same everytime, the terms and conditions can be agreed and accepted at the first login. It is annoying when it pops up twice every single time the app is opened.

In-App Support Intercept & Forced Rating.text: App is poorly developed. There are lot of technical issues. Textboxes do not support autocorrect and autocomplete so you have to type every letter and auto correct word gets erased. Even if you provide feedback through received notification app does not understand it and ask me to again provide feedback upon opening & blocks me. ETA for pickup and drops are very poorly calculated, always off by big margins. I have reported these bugs through app. I can't see status of bugs as well.

I had a very disappointing experience with Move In Sync. The cab was shown at a different location due to a glitch in the app, but the driver reached the correct location and left without picking me up. When I contacted the helpdesk for assistance, their response was unhelpful, and they did not communicate with me politely. The lack of cooperation and poor customer service was very frustrating.

Very worst app. I didn't see the tracking and distance will give more and also time tracking is also worst. Instead of this I can see other apps are working souch good. And also the cab is coming for pick up location 1 hour before even though the office location is just 20 mins to my location. I have given complaint on this so many times but no response from the move in sync team. Theor response is very bad and worst.

Do you even read the comments ??? Or just Blabber !!!! On multiple occasions i have observed that the app while booking a parking slot will always show waiting for me but on the other hand my colleague will always have slots available. Not an isolated scenario other colleagues also have seen the same behaviour. Seems the app gives preference to some Not sure why the discrepancies. I have written to the mail team multiple times but got no reply. Hence added it here.

Route Assignment & Detours.text: The people operating it at our office are inefficient . Most of the time the cabs are late. Majority drivers are rude and arrogant. Deny to take you even if they are assigned your ID on their device, coz they don't 'feel like' going that route. The drivers are not professional at all when it comes to driving as well. When you drop a complaint, it is ignored. Will not recommend anybody. Worst App ever !

This app doesn't provides cab according to the route rather it clubs the exact opposite route and had to travel in Cab for almost an hour to reach office which usually takes only 15 mins. Was same for drop. Beyond providing same feedback everyday on the same issue no improvements in the route. It's been a month and it's pathetic experience with this Moveinsync service and app. Even after cancelling the cab before the buffer time, it still gives notifications saying that fellow passenger has boarded the cab and be ready to board the cab. This isn't good. It doesnt provides exact time or locations to track the cab. Don't use this app or service.

After the latest update passengers are unable to find the route assigned to the vehicle. I used to see the route, who's gonna get picked next and i could get an estimate time of arrival. Now it's only showing me and the driver. Therefore unable to assume the pick ups proir or the route driver is following.

We cannot check how many people are there on the route and when is our pick up timing. We cannot check our phone regularly to check where is the cab. GPS is showing a differnt pick up place. We reached 20 minutes early before the office timing.

Driver Punctuality & Behaviour.text: It is the worst app. There is no transparency about the passenger who are traveling with you, it doesn't give real-time information. It's not user friendly. There is some or the other issues when it comes to contacting the driver. It is definitely not a helpful app. Any changes made to the app is to complicate things for users, the current version is always worst than previous one. I fail to understand what is the purpose of this app.

The least you can be is a bit professional. 1. Never picks up on time. 2. Gives false information on pickup and arrival time. 3. Driver makes unplanned stops and when questioned, turns hostile. Time is of essence to all your users and to you. Please make sure you don't waste it, that too consistently. I am thinking of discontinuing soon and will never recommend to another colleague or company if your services don't improve.

App has very poor logic of setting zoom level and automatically reset it every 30 seconds. When user is waiting for cab at source why you want to keep the destination also in the view? which makes impossible to see how far the cab is. suggestion to keep one point at a time in focus while boarding pickup point and vehicle and once you start the trip vehicle and destination. also when user zooms in respect his zooming don't reset automatically optionally you can give reset button to reset.

The GPS tracking system is often unreliable and sometimes shows the driver at an incorrect location, which can lead to unnecessary delays. In addition, the estimated arrival time displayed by the GPS tracker is frequently inaccurate, and the pickup time is rarely synchronized correctly. This has occasionally resulted in missed cab pickups. Notifications are also often delayed or, at times, not received at all, causing me to miss important updates regarding my ride.
